catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class expresses an acknowledged stop of dashboard program execution with an empty fixed Trigger request. cap.motion.stop.v1 is a motion-stop class that declares a deceleration profile and stopped/stopping-position outputs, none of which the upstream std_srvs/srv/Trigger accepts or reports; binding it would claim a motion stop the service does not confirm.

No catalogue class exposes an observational program-running boolean through an application-checked service response. Catalogue searches for running, state, status, program and execution return no such class, so the driver uses a read-verb extension with an inline output schema.

notes:
Passed the fake gate on the pinned clone; evidence is contract_checked, not an MHS-Device level. This package is a configuration-only RosDriver for two private services of the C++ dashboard_client node: the fixed-request std_srvs/srv/Trigger ~/stop service and the observational ur_dashboard_msgs/srv/IsProgramRunning ~/program_running service. Stop is an input-free Action(safe_state=True) and also the native stop binding; the state query is an operation=read action with the application success predicate checked and only program_running returned. Both checks use the response's success field, not the rosbridge transport flag. The fake exercises service_response.result=false, application success=false and a missing success field for both endpoints; after a failed stop its program-running flag stays true, so no stopped state is reported. The stop action output is only the dashboard acknowledgement; it does not claim a motion stop, zero velocity, power isolation or a safety-rated channel. The clone cites no independent hardware e-stop, so estop_physical_ref is not set; SAFE-045 is satisfied by the input-free safe-state action, which is a second runtime path to the same dashboard stop service and not a physical stop. risk is R2 because the dashboard belongs to a robot arm, above the card's R0 floor. The endpoints /dashboard_client/stop and /dashboard_client/program_running are explicit deployment assumptions: the node must be launched with the launch file's dashboard_client name in the root namespace, or remapped to these absolute names. An e-stop can invoke the native stop binding and then the safe-state action, so the fake records two acknowledged stop calls; neither is turned into a physical-stop claim. The runtime latches extension actions, so the program-running x-cap action is refused after an e-stop until a reset; before a stop it returns only the dashboard flag. No hardware backend, ROS graph, rosbridge WebSocket or robot was contacted; the fake is an F0 recording/contract fixture with placeholder values. The clone was not modified. NOT COVERED: play, resume, brake release, power on/off, unlock protective stop, clear operational mode, restart safety, raw request, program-state/safety/robot-mode queries, shutdown, joint/cartesian motion and every other dashboard service; only the two endpoints above are bound. The gate reports one warning, G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE: the package has no numeric actuating input, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe and the suite awards CL2; every other CL3 test passed. The cited Trigger and IsProgramRunning requests are empty, so no sourced numeric bound exists to add; inventing one would violate the source contract. The package is model-authored and driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null; the loader refuses its ROS hardware backend until a human signs a hardware review, regardless of the fake result.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6, a model and not a human, 2026-11-02; reviewed_by stays null): FIX then ACCEPT for fake contract_checked evidence. Independently reviewed every endpoint/type/fact and the complete driver, fake and tests against the pin; application failure, ROS failure and missing fields do not claim success. R2 and the dashboard-only stop scope are appropriate. Corrected driver.py comments to distinguish normal safe-state invocation from e-stop latching, limited the upstream node-name Fact to the cited source, and clarified acknowledgement wording in facts.md. Reviewer changed driver.py, facts.md, generated reference.json and REFERENCE.md, check-report.json and RESULT.json; original files were preserved privately. The gate passes with the current stable digest; no numeric actuation means SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and CL2. Observational extension actions correctly remain latched while the declared stop stays callable. No physical stop, zero velocity, power isolation, live ROS, robot run, human signature or publication is verified. The orchestrator also regenerated task.json through prepare.py --sync after the registry build; it was not edited by hand.
